objectives.text: ProMaxScore is a project that provides self-help and analysis tools for businesses.
The goal of ProMaxScore is to help businesses stay strong and operational for a long time.
ProMaxScore targets entrepreneurs of small and medium enterprises (SMEs).
The project aims to save SMEs time and money.
ProMaxScore claims that SMEs can save from $2,000 to $25,000 immediately by using their tools.
95% of small and medium enterprises provide jobs in the marketplace.
There are roughly 25,000,000 enterprises in North America alone.
80% of new businesses fail within 5 years.
The funding period for ProMaxScore was from May 19, 2015, to June 13, 2015.
Funding for the ProMaxScore project was canceled by the project creator on June 8, 2015.
ProMaxScore Enterprise Booster is a rated self-analysis tool designed to help entrepreneurs assess their business.
The tool requires users to answer 145 questions, which are broken down into 6 categories.
Users receive an overall business score and action plan after completing the self-analysis.
ProMaxScore offers four tools that are fully developed and operational in Excel or Word.
One of the tools is ProMaxScore Enterprise Booster, which includes 145 questions that generate a self-diagnostic on company operations.
The ProMaxScore Enterprise Booster provides an action plan summary to suggest possible solutions.
The ProMaxScore summary includes a total score of 64%, categorized as Excellent.
The ProMaxScore summary also includes a total revised score of 64%, categorized as Excellent.
The B0 STRATEGIES & MISSION section has an importance rating of 2, with a total score of 61% and a revised score of 58%.
